title: parosela humilis
intro: Parosela humilis, commonly known as the Pterospermum, is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Parosela humilis include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body against various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Parosela humilis include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
